verdict.rationale: GitHub documents first-party issue creation and project management ("Create issues and manage projects", "Organize everything from high-level roadmaps to everyday tasks"), and issues are reachable from the CLI, mobile app and the issue-to-PR workflow. Assignees are confirmed only indirectly, by a community note that free private repos lose "multiple assignees". missing for 10: explicit documentation of labels, first-party documentation of assignees, coverage of typing issues as bugs/features/requirements, independent hands-on corroboration.
